name: package-smoke
argv:
python -m pip wheel . --no-deps --wheel-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel"
python -m pip install --no-deps --target "${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" "${RUNNER_TEMP}"/memorii-wheel/*.whl
cd "${RUNNER_TEMP}"
PYTHONPATH="${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" python -c "from pathlib import Path; import memorii; root=Path('${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site').resolve(); assert Path(memorii.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root); from memorii.core.memory_evolution.extraction_contracts import MemoryExtractionOutput; from memorii.core.prompts.runtime_manifest import PromptOwner; from memorii.core.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry; PromptRegistry().load('memory_extraction:v1', owner=PromptOwner.LLM_MEMORY_EXTRACTOR, output_model=MemoryExtractionOutput)"
PYTHONPATH="${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" python -c "from pathlib import Path; import memorii.core.benchmark.memory_evolution_sim as sim, memorii.core.benchmark.memory_evolution_runtime as runtime, memorii.tools.run_benchmark as runner; root=Path('${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site').resolve(); assert all(Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root) for module in (sim, runtime, runner))"
PYTHONPATH="${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" python -c "from importlib.util import find_spec; removed=('memorii.core.promotion.models', 'memorii.core.promotion.legacy_models', 'memorii.core.promotion.lifecycle_models', 'memorii.core.prompts.manifest', 'memorii.core.prompts.schema_compatibility'); assert all(find_spec(module) is None for module in removed)"
PYTHONPATH="${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" python -m memorii.tools.run_eval --suite memory_evolution_sim_v1 --mode llm --dry-run --storage-root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-benchmark" --sim-profile long_horizon --sim-scenario-count 1 --sim-min-events 5 --sim-max-events 10 --sim-noise-rate 0.35 --seed 7
PYTHONPATH="${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-site" python -m memorii.tools.validate_benchmark_artifacts --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/memorii-wheel-benchmark/benchmark_runs" --suite memory_evolution_sim_v1
